sources: dossier=message-sender-node.md Corrections and restorations: 'Same-tx invariant was false doc (2026-06-23, 10cf843b): the concept doc claimed the envelope inserts in the node's terminal-resolution transaction; user ruled the doc wrong ("yes, fix the doc")' plus Net position 'The envelope inserts in its own transaction during the handler call, not the node's terminal-resolution transaction' (2026-06-23); doc=message-sender-node.md line 24 (pre-fix) said the send-tx atomic unit was 'envelope row + frame enqueue, atomic with each other'; code=sendCascadeMessageInTx (lib/runtime/runner_send_message.go) runs MessageIdempotencies().InsertOrLookup + EnqueueMessage only -- EnqueueMessage (lib/runtime/message_delivery.go) does Instances().Get, optional coalesce-cancel, and Messages().Insert, no Frames() write; frame opening happens later in SweepDeliverMessagesForRunningFrames, a distinct transaction
note: message-sender-node.md was NOT touched by the parallel remediation pass (git status shows no pending change on this file prior to this ruling), so the finding was still live. The doc's claimed atomic unit (envelope + frame enqueue) contradicted both the code and the dossier's own transcript-tier statement that the send-tx is separate from terminal-resolution and that frame delivery is a distinct downstream step. Fixed invariant 2 in message-sender-node.md to state the send-tx is atomic with the idempotency record only, and that frame opening is a separate downstream pickup step.
